qualifications: PhD conferred by the start of the award term and within the last three years

description_short: Postdoctoral fellowship of up to two years at the Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability, starting September 2027, in Earth, oceans, energy, civil and environmental engineering and emerging sustainability fields. Applicants need a recent PhD (within three years) and at most two years of postdoc experience.
